description:
Change a comment thread's resolution without posting a reply. Pass
    comment_id from list_comments (threads[].id); omit resolved or set it
    true to resolve, and set resolved=false to reopen. Comments must be
    enabled and the thread writable. Returns the thread ID and resulting
    resolved flag. Use reply_comment to post a message instead.
    Requires envelopes:send access.
name: resolve_comment
title: Resolve or Reopen Comment
